reviews.text: The best of the best

Absolutely amazing experience so far! They’re very direct, transparent, and honest about what to expect. We started with an evaluation for Melo, and they took the time to explain everything clearly while giving us realistic expectations and a plan moving forward.

We’ve only had two training sessions so far, and I can already see a huge improvement in Melo, especially when we’re out in public. I’m really happy with the progress and would definitely recommend them to anyone looking for knowledgeable, straightforward, and effective dog trainers.

I had such an amazing experience with Asger K9! From the very beginning, they were incredibly professional, attentive, and caring with my puppy, Marlo. You can truly tell how much they love and care about the dogs they work with.

Marlo always looked so happy and excited while staying there, which gave me so much peace of mind. When he came home, I could immediately see such a positive difference in his behavior and training. He came back so well-behaved, and I couldn’t be happier with the results!

They were also very careful and attentive throughout the entire process, and I always felt that Marlo was in great hands. I’m so grateful for everything they did for him and would absolutely recommend Asgker K9 to anyone looking for a professional, loving, and trustworthy training team! ❤️🐾

We couldn’t be happier with our experience with Asger K9! They worked with our Doberman puppy, Rio Grande, and the difference in his behavior has been amazing.

Rio is a young, energetic Doberman, so having the right training and guidance from the beginning was extremely important to us. The trainers at Asger K9 have done a wonderful job helping him learn obedience, confidence, and how to behave appropriately in different environments.

We recently took Rio to a baseball game with lots of people, noise, and distractions, and he did GREAT! He was calm, well-behaved, and listened to us throughout the game. Being able to take our puppy out in public and actually enjoy the experience showed us just how much his training has paid off.

We are so proud of the progress Rio has made and truly appreciate everything Asger K9 has done for him and for us as owners. If you’re looking for knowledgeable, patient, and effective dog trainers, we highly recommend Asger K9! 🐾❤️

Thank you for helping our Rio Grande become such a well-behaved young Doberman!

I used Asger K-9 to help with my boy Macho. He was very anxious and afraid all of the time. He loves being in the backyard, but we couldn't leave him out there for very long or he would tear it up. Chewing on anything and everything. He was terrified of any dogs that were his size or bigger. After Asger took him in for a few weeks, they gave me back a brand new dog. He is well behaved, listens and is an amazing body guard. He is now a vet and does consultations. I posted a picture of him in his uniform... JK LOL.  I recommend Asger to anyone that asks and sometimes they don't ask. If you have any concerns about your pup/pups, talk to them. They are trustworthy, caring and knowledgable. They always respond and help keep up with training. I don't know what else I can say to convince you, just do it already!

I’m very happy with my experience with Asger K9. My dog used to be reactive and didn’t like being around other dogs. He would pull on walks, struggle to listen around distractions, and become tense whenever he saw another dog. After training, he is much more focused, walks are easier, and our communication has improved. He is no longer reactive and now wants to play with every dog he sees. The trainer also taught me how to continue the training at home. I highly recommend Asger K9!

Our boy blue is a stubborn guy! but this team completely changed it all for us! We knew from the moment he was dropped off that this team was 100% the right choice. They hear out all your concerns and dedicated an incredible amount of time and patience to blue to get him ready to come back home to us, and for that we are forever grateful!! They keep you updated, send pics, and even let you come visit and see how your pup is doing! They also dedicate time to the owners to ensure you understand everything and teach you all you need to know on the training when you’re on your own! Blue was a very happy pup while he was there he with all the other dogs playing and they take exceptional care of them, you can really tell they love what they do! Again, we thank you guys for everything and even though we missed Blue while he was gone, this was 100% the right choice and will definitely benefit Blue and our family forever. If you are looking to take your pup in the right direction and see incredible results as soon as they are back home, they are definitely the team to call!!

I had the pleasure of working with Eddie and Rey. I thought my dog was difficult and untamable but honestly they did such an amazing job at training her, I’m highly impressed. It feels so good to be able to walk her and pet her without the chaos.

my dog bruno was a menace, he yanked on the leash, barked at everyone he seen and i felt like i couldn't live the life i wanted to because of him.

i talked to eddie and i was kinda nervous about sending my dog because i wasn't sure if it was gonna work. i got my dog back about 4 days ago and i am just amazed with the results, he has not pulled on the leash once, he is doesn't bark at everyone he sees anymore and the customer support is top tier.

i had to get a checkup for my dog because before hand i couldn't take him to vet clinics because of how aggressive he was. So eddie went ahead and let me bring bruno while he had a vet come to their office and handle everything for me. i dropped bruno off at asger k9, met with the vet and in 20 minutes, bruno got a checkup, got medication and he was good to go.

i'm extremely happy with the results and i just put my 5 month weenie dog in there, yesterday i came to drop off food and in 1 week, he's already sitting, walking by the heel and listens to everything.

i never thought it was possible for my dog bruno to be this calm and perfect. I work from home and he just sits next to me and won't move till i tell him to. Before hand he used to walk around, knock things over, chew on my stuff and now he's just everything i wanted in a dog.

i just had my first class when bruno got dropped off and i swear i asked the same question 3 times because i didn't understand and the trainer never made me feel stupid for asking more then twice.

Once again, I'm thankful for everything AsgerK9 did for me and my dog.

I’m good friends with Asgerk9 Juan I rescued a Belgian mali that needed a better home Bonnie has come so far as I’ve had her now 2 years I recommend Juan for any of his services follow him on instagram ASGERK9

If you’re looking for a dog trainer in the PA/NJ area, I can’t recommend Kleyner enough. Working with him has completely changed our lives and our relationship with our dog. Before training, we struggled with behaviors that made everyday life stressful, but Kleyner brought patience, structure, and an incredible understanding of dogs that made all the difference.
What stands out most is how much he truly cares — not just about training the dog, but about helping owners build confidence and create a stronger bond with their pets. The transformation in our dog has been amazing, but honestly, the biggest change has been in our home and daily life. Walks are enjoyable, we feel more connected, and there’s a sense of calm and trust we didn’t have before.
Kleyner is professional, knowledgeable, and genuinely passionate about what he does. We’re beyond grateful for everything he’s done for  us, I would recommend him to anyone in the Pennsylvania/New Jersey area looking for real results and lasting change.

Juan and his team are amazing. They are very knowledgeable and responsive to calls and text messages. The treat your pets like family. My Cali is doing amazing now. Recall has improved tremendously. I highly recommend them.

You can tell they genuinely care, because they were patient and made sure my dogs understood each command step by step. Now they listen much better, behave around people, and are way more calm and confident.

This is THE place to get your dog or puppy trained. I brought my 4 month old toy poodle, Mocha, in to work on obedience and discipline, and when I got her back today, the difference was night and day. She listens so much better, understands her commands, and is overall much more well-behaved.

One thing I really appreciated is that they do not just train your dog,  they train you too. You cannot expect your dog to come back perfectly obedient if you continue allowing old habits at home. Dogs will naturally try to go back to what they were used to before, but the Asger K9 team really makes sure both you and your dog are set up for success.

Overall, this was a 10/10 experience. They treated Mocha so well, kept me updated throughout the process, and were always communicative and professional. I would absolutely recommend this company to anyone looking for dog training.

Words cannot express how happy and grateful I am that I found you all when I did. I cannot thank Rey, Juan and Eddy enough. When I first took Falcon to you guys I was at my wits end with him. I did not realize how broken he was, through no fault of his. But I also did not want to give up on him. It took a long time, but I can honestly see the change in him from when I first dropped him off to now that he’s been home. Rey, Juan and Eddy are true miracle workers. I am looking forward to my future training sessions with Rey and Falcon.

I had to take a 3 week trip and was desperate to find someone to not only care for my dog but teach him. I friend of mine recommended Asger K9 to me and i couldnt possibly be more grateful that we found Asger K9. Our dog came back with his same personality but completely unrecognizable when it came to obedience. These people are great, patient, and truly caring for our animals. I 100% recommend these people for both training and boarding. The price was also extremely reasonable for the amount of time i left him and of course included the training as well. Truly recommend!!

I can't say enough good things about Asger K9. I know the owner and staff personally and have witnessed their training firsthand and I must say it is truly next level.. The amount of skill, knowledge, and dedication they bring to every single dog is incredible. They don’t just train dogs; they understand them. Watching their process and seeing the progress dogs make is honestly amazing. Every session is handled with patience, confidence, and genuine care, and the results speak for themselves. If you’re looking for top-tier dog training from people who are passionate, professional, and insanely good at what they do, Asger K9 is absolutely the place to go.
Great service and did an excellent job at training my dog Oso! They handled everything professionally and efficiently

If I could give zero stars, I would. My dog was with this trainer for six weeks — they claimed to know his temperament, routine, and needs. Yet in AUGUST, they dropped him, causing both of his front legs to break. Let that sink in — both legs.

Because of their carelessness and lack of basic safety, my dog went from being confident and well-trained to being traumatized and stuck in a cage for months, losing every bit of progress he had made. He’s been in pain, terrified, and unable to walk normally — all because of their negligence.

And the insult on top of the injury? They still haven’t refunded me for the unfinished boarding and training I paid for — money they absolutely did not earn. Instead, I was left with thousands in vet bills and a brokenhearted dog who now needs rehab instead of training.

This entire experience has been disgusting, heartbreaking, and infuriating. I would never recommend this place to anyone who actually loves their dog. They talk like professionals but clearly don’t take the responsibility seriously. My advice: run the other way — don’t risk your pet’s life with people who can’t even hold onto them safely.

EDIT / UPDATE TO MY ORIGINAL REVIEW:

I’ve tried resolving this privately multiple times via text, and I have proof of every attempt. I brought two dogs and paid for boarding, but neither completed their stay because one was injured under your care in August and had to be taken for emergency treatment.

Because of that, the boarding service was never finished — yet I still haven’t received any refund for the days that were cut short.

I was only notified of the injury when I was asked to sign off on the anesthesia, not at the time the incident occurred. Additionally, they initially intended to use a veterinarian I had no prior information about. I requested a change to a specialist experienced in treating these types of fractures in greyhounds, given the known anesthesia-related complications associated with the breed.

My dog has spent months recovering in a cage and lost all of his training progress. Covering part of the medical costs does not erase the fact that I paid for boarding and training that were never fully delivered.

This isn’t about “milking” anyone — it’s about accountability. I paid for services that were never provided, and I’ve made every effort to resolve this respectfully and directly. The messages prove that.
Very good trainer

Run away from this place and fast - not only could they not train one of our dogs basic commands after a FOUR WEEK BOARDING PROGRAM they didnt fix or even improve our dogs reactivity towards one another. Our dogs got into a fight the day they were home from the program, and the program was our last resort. We have spent so much money from the $4000 we paid for the program to the vet bills after; one of our dogs came back with an INFECTION all over her underside. Did the company mention this to us when they gave her back to us? No, but apparently they train with them multiple times a day. Another vet bill for one of our dogs injured leg after the fight the same day they got back. Lastly the rehoming fees that included vet bills, crates, flights, and gas. Does all the money add up? Yes, but we care more about the lost chance for our dogs to become friends again and for us to all be under one roof. Instead we had to re-home one of our family members.
When it comes to anything behavioral they have no idea what they are doing, not sure if they even know what they are doing with regular commands. They use choke collars on the dogs, so is the dog doing it because they are trained or because they are scared you are about pop their neck?
Please do not make the same mistake we did and do not use this company.
i had an amazing experience with my dog being taking cared of at their facility and i will come back very soon

I am writing this review because I was blown away by THE most INCREDIBLE customer service experience I’ve ever had! I had the pleasure of speaking with Eddie, who made sure I received an important call back, same day. Although we were not a compatible match, he still made sure to pass along invaluable advice in my search. Such honesty from a business is almost unheard of nowadays. I would recommend them to anyone in search of a specialty trainer, based solely off of this conversation! 5 stars!

I had an amazing experience with Asger K9. Benji was very reactive towards other dogs and people, to the point that I could not walk him or take him out in public. Even aggressive in some cases. Benji came back a completely changed dog and for the better; more confident, refined, and obedient. Rey and Juan were super helpful from beginning to end and amazing at easing any worries or stress that I had. I would 100% recommend. Thank you guys!

The best decision ever made.  We took Kumo a 2 yr old Samoyed with lots of attitude and non stop barking...must say super happy with the results and we are not yet done.  The difference is huge..we can now enjoy our dog a lot more Thanks to AsgerK9.  Highly recomended!!!!

I can’t say enough good things about Asger K9. We rescued a Bully, and while I instantly bonded with her, she did not get along with my wife and stepson. It was a stressful situation, and I knew we needed help. After searching on Yelp, I found this trainer and scheduled an in-home evaluation.

From the start, Juan impressed me with his knowledge and professionalism. He even offered a 3-day boot camp at no cost, and when our dog came back, she was like a completely different dog. That alone showed me how skilled he was. We immediately enrolled her in the full board-and-train program, and the results were nothing short of life-changing.

When our dog returned, she and my wife bonded right away—something I wasn’t sure would ever happen. The trainer (shout out to Ronald) not only worked wonders with her but also gave us detailed explanations of her behavior, why she was reacting the way she did, and how to correct unwanted behavior going forward.
I get compliments all the time on how well trained my dog is.

Thanks to Asger K9’s expertise and dedication, our family now has the harmony we hoped for. I would highly recommend Asger K9 to anyone dealing with behavioral challenges or just looking to better understand their dog.
Almost killed my dog, owner never responds back

I can’t say enough good things about AsgerK9. They’ve been patient, knowledgeable, and dedicated to helping me understand and train my dog, Raya. It’s not just about commands—it’s about trust, communication, and making her the best version of herself.

They explain the “why” behind everything, which has made me a better handler. Since training with them, Raya’s obedience, focus, and overall behavior has improved so much.

If you want a trainer who truly cares and gets real results, I highly recommend AsgerK9.

Juan is such a talented trainer! He trained my service animal Ravioli! I love the follow up training sessions and that I can always send him a message and he will get back to you. One of the best investments I have made!

Outstanding Training Experience with Asgerk9

I am not an easy client and I’m very picky about everything and anything. With that being said,  I will always use Asgerk9 for training my pocket bully, Bruce. He started the program at 4 months old. I am thrilled with the outcome from their board and train program. From our first meeting with Juan, it was clear that he has a profound understanding of dog behaviors and effective training especially with my silly lil pup. The best part about that meeting is that he respected my particular ways with the dog. I wanted him to be trained with the least amount of treats possible and he eats a raw food diet. Juan was respectful towards my requests and they did exactly that.

Juan, Rey, and Pablo are always professional and communicated effectively whenever I reached out to them for updates on Bruce. They took the time to explain each training technique in a way that was easy for both Bruce and myself to grasp.

The training methods used by Asgerk9 were not only humane but highly effective. Bruce showed significant improvements in his behavior, particularly with focus, attention and on leash training, within just a few weeks. One thing i absolutely loved was that you can visit your pup wherever they’re training that day and see how the trainer works in action so it’s easier to understand when you pick him up. Asgerk9 also provided us with not only the tools but effective strategies to continue Bruce's personalized training at home, which has been incredibly helpful.

I want to emphasize the personalized training because there are certain things that I needed him to do as far as tasks and they made it very simple for me to go ahead and teach him these things.

Asgerk9's patience was and continues to be remarkable (both with Bruce and myself). Training can be challenging, Bruce is a pit mixed w staffy so even as a puppy they are strong and silly but AsgerK9’s calm and positive approach made the process enjoyable for Bruce and myself. Their kindness helped in establishing trust, which I believe was crucial to our success.

After completing the training program with Asgerk9, Bruce is now much more obedient, responsive, and well-mannered in various situations. He goes absolutely everywhere with us. And the best part is that he understands the program even if it changes.

We had a medical emergency at a restaurant for my son and it was very easy to go from a simple pace to a fast one. Bruce had the understanding of all the commands that he needed to accomplish, especially considering the speed that everything was going at in that moment. The transformation has been nothing short of amazing, and it's all thanks to Asgerk9's expertise.

I wholeheartedly recommend Asgerk9 to any dog owner looking for a skilled and no bs trainer. Whether you're dealing with basic obedience or more complex issues, Asgerk9 has the knowledge and approach to help.

**Rating:** 5/5

Asgerk9 was definitely a life changing experience for my dog and I. Before Asgerk9 I was not able to walk with Sasha let alone have her around my family due to her jumping on others and not listening. Today thanks to the board and train I am able to take Sasha everywhere walk with her anywhere, And socialize her with my guests and family. They took the time to train and make her a better dog every day. There was such great improvement in Sasha’s behavior since then I have been very happy to be able to walk my dog and have her play with my son . Juan and Rey have been very professional, honest, and I would say are definitely the best dog trainers ever. Thank you Asgerk9 for bringing Sasha home and thank you for allowing me to keep up with training and enjoying my best friend.

I can’t say enough great things about Asger K9! They did an incredible job training my 2 yr old Belgian Malinois in both obedience and bite work. It was so hard for me to leave her in training for 3 weeks but they would always answer the phone, send me pictures, and let me visit my baby!

I was unsure how well she would do considering she’s already an adult but the obedience training was amazing she’s a whole new dog!

The bite work was also impressive. They built up her drive and confidence.  It’s clear they truly love dogs and enjoy teaching them. I couldn’t thank Juan, Pablo, and Rey enough! I’m so happy with the results!

You guys, this is best investment ever. I have a deaf Dalmatian with a lot of energy and severe separation anxiety. I contacted asgerk9, juan and Rey have been nothing but amazing in this journey. These guys really know what they're doing! Definitely something you won’t regret
